title: ControlNet branch compressed into Mirror views
hypothesis: One shared spatial control encoder plus small per-condition orthogonal channel Views preserves condition-specific control maps at lower complete serialized bytes than copied branches and improves over hard tying/FiLM.
physical_object: shared two-layer convolutional spatial control branch
mirror_coordinate: per-condition Givens channel rotation at the hidden control feature

development.selection_metric: heldout spatial output nRMSE, actual complete branch payload bytes and convolution/view MAC proxy

fresh.reason: no audit after exact native Givens alias or failed byte gate

storage.authority: actual serialized complete inference branch bytes

success_gate: Heldout nRMSE <=.02, >=25% complete bytes saved versus independent copies, strict frontier gain over FiLM and native direct Givens controls.
failure_gate: Quality/byte miss or exact native Givens function/payload alias is FAIL for Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: Synthetic spatial control branch only; no pretrained diffusion model.
No prompt/image generation or aesthetic quality claim.
